decision.if: gbrain-fix beats gbrain-before on H4 for claude-opus-5-5 (primary interval above 0) and the other four families show no harm (pooled lower bound above -5 points)
decision.then: GBRA-108 keeps the fix on by default; README's H4 limit line is replaced with this result and the remaining gap to files; H4 work moves to manager-phrase resolution

decision.if: the fix helps on H4 but harm on the other families is not ruled out
decision.then: GBRA-108 is asked to scope the default to the cases that helped, with the per-family split; README's H4 line waits for the scoped change

decision.if: the primary difference is not distinguishable from 0
decision.then: one Why-null cycle from the transcript statistics, then a KEEP, FIX-METHOD or CUT-CANDIDATE verdict on the default (cut candidates reported to Garry); H4 work moves to manager-phrase resolution

decision.if: the fix hurts on H4 (primary interval below 0)
decision.then: GBRA-108 reverts the default, with the paired numbers

decision.if: gbrain-fix is level with files on H4
decision.then: README says gbrain is level with plain files on these questions, with the interval

decision.if: gbrain-fix is still behind files on H4
decision.then: README says so with the number, and the manager-phrase share of the gap goes to GBRA-108

decision.if: the gap between gbrain-fix and files on H4 is not distinguishable
decision.then: README gives the gap with its interval and says the run cannot tell level from behind
